objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed document that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution and archiving lifecycle

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier composed of abbreviation, consecutive number, and title

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Document type such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, or Work Instruction

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status in the lifecycle such as editing or released

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document is valid

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document describing locally defined or business process-related regulations and instructions

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document describing specific procedures and process sequences with responsible persons

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document describing detailed work steps, test instructions and compliance criteria for sub-processes

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document automatically released with the main document that triggers new version when modified

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Document supplement not subject to main document release cycle and can be deleted directly

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Whether additional information is published or not

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal to amend a document without affecting content or version history until implementation

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person who interacts with the document management system

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, or Translator

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users assigned for authorization and distribution purposes

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of users and user groups who receive document notifications and authorizations

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Distribution type such as email or acknowledgement

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: Request created to check and extend document validity before expiration

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the validity extension request

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request to invalidate and archive a document with no additional validity

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request to reactivate a previously invalidated document

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Electronic signature of workflow participants documenting approval

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attach new document object to the system with selected document type and template

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type selected for the new document

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modify document content using the implemented editing client and Office formats

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: Source format such as Excel, Word, or PowerPoint

evts.name: maintain_properties
evts.description: Define and update document metadata and attributes including categories and standardized values

evts.name: assign_authorizations
evts.description: Assign group and person-related permissions and roles for document access and modification

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Role for which authorization is assigned

evts.name: initiate_release
evts.description: Start the workflow-supported approval process for document release

evts.name: author_sign
evts.description: Registered author signs the document creation in the first workflow step

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Assigned reviewers check document content according to technical and formal aspects

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser approves document and triggers distribution to readers

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Document automatically published and made visible to addressed readers after release

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Released document automatically converted to PDF format for web display

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: New version automatically created when released document is revised or when changes trigger versioning

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: Reason for version creation such as content change or attachment modification

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Author creates change proposal for document without affecting content or version history

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Change proposal scheduled for implementation creating new document version

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System automatically creates request when document reaches 30 days before validity expiration

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Releaser or author/reviewer/releaser confirms document remains valid and updates validity date

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: User with write access creates request to invalidate document with no additional validity

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: Document and attachments declared invalid and archived after workflow approval

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which document is archived

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Business Admin group creates request to reactivate previously invalidated document

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Initiator confirms reactivation and new version created with retained metadata

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Assigned users and user groups receive email notification upon document release

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Assigned users and groups automatically requested to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release

attributes.name: recipient
attributes.description: User or group required to acknowledge

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement of document through workflow task

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translator translates released document content into another language

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Assigned reviewers check translated document content

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Translator or releaser approves translation for publication to readers in target language

o2o.description: Document contains attachments that are controlled and released together
Document is supplemented with additional information not subject to release cycle
Change proposal belongs to and is displayed in the document
Documents can reference other documents through properties
Validity extension request is linked to the document being checked
Override request is created for a selected document
Change proposal references the underlying document

o2e.description: Document is created through attachment as new information object
Document content is edited in the system
Document properties and metadata are maintained
Authorizations and roles are assigned to document via properties
Release process is initiated for the document
Author signs the document in the release process
Document is reviewed by assigned reviewers
Document is released and approved for distribution
Document is published to readers after release
Document is converted to PDF format after release
New version of document is created
Change proposal is created for document
Change proposal is scheduled for implementation
Validity extension request is created for document
Validity extension request is processed and validity is extended
Override request is created for document
Override request is processed and document is invalidated
Reactivation request is created for document
Reactivation request is processed and document is reactivated
Distribution list is used to send email notifications
Distribution list is used to request acknowledgements
User confirms acknowledgement of document
Document is translated into another language
Translation of document is reviewed
Translation of document is released
